newsitem.title: UK: Whitbread to crack down on alcopop sales-paper.
newsitem.headline: Whitbread to crack down on alcopop sales-paper.

text.p: UK's Whitbread Plc will crack down on the sale of alcopops to under-age drinkers, the Financial Times said on Monday.
Whitbread, one of the biggest manufacturers of the sweet alcoholic drinks, also has been in touch with the Home Office suggesting a series of measures to curb teenage drinking, the paper said.
The UK government has made it clear that it will ban alcopops unless it is confident that the industry is taking steps to restrict sales to under-age drinkers. --London Newsroom +44 171 542 5106
